product: Czech DMR5G bare-earth terrain;2m native raster exported as F32/None in EPSG4326,500x360 pixels; grid sampled at6m. Exact acquisition date at this castle is unknown.
attribution: © ČÚZK; DMR5G. Derived samples and native-frame reprojection by Molen.
heightDatum: Baltic after adjustment Bpv EPSG8357 metres
rasterSampling: Bilinear at pixel centers of the declared returned EPSG4326 extent; no hillshade/byte-color elevations.
limitations: Ground below buildings is interpolated bare-earth terrain, not a floor survey. Courtyard and range roof levels remain reconstructed working elevations.
The retained6m grid is a visual-review fixture, not shipped forced terrain. Runtime uses relative grade and a host-supplied terrain reference.
